features.title: Drive DSH threads from an outside agent over MCP
features.summary: Serve an MCP server (streamable HTTP, stateless, JSON responses) at /mcp on the DSH Web server. Claude Code, Codex or any MCP client with the bearer token can list projects and threads, read a thread's recent messages, create a thread with a first prompt and model, queue or steer a message, wait for the turn to end (at most 5 minutes) and stop a turn. Every tool is a sessions API call made as @dshfiles/mcp-endpoint.
failureModes: Without an issued token every request gets 401 naming Settings › MCP endpoint, where the token is generated.
A wrong or rotated token gets 401; the DSH launch cookie is never accepted instead.
A client on another machine gets 403 until LAN access is turned on.
A request with a browser Origin other than the endpoint's own host gets 403 (DNS-rebinding protection).
A body over 1 MiB gets 413; a non-JSON body gets a JSON-RPC parse error.
A refused sessions call (unknown thread, busy agent, missing session-controller) reaches the MCP client as a tool error with DSH's message and code.

externalDependencies.boundary: Every MCP tool except list_projects is one sessionsApi call (list, messages, create, prompt, wait, interrupt) made in process as @dshfiles/mcp-endpoint; the endpoint never touches native Session services itself.
externalDependencies.deterministicFake: src/mcp-endpoint.test.ts mounts a sessionsApi owner that records the calls and drives it with the official MCP SDK client over real HTTP.

features.title: Issue the MCP token and copy the Claude Code command
features.summary: Settings › MCP endpoint shows the endpoint URL, generates or rotates the bearer token and shows it once with a copyable `claude mcp add --transport http dsh <url> --header "Authorization: Bearer …"` command, revokes it, and turns LAN access on or off. Only the token's SHA-256 is stored. The agent can read the status, revoke the token (explicit confirm) and switch LAN access; it cannot issue a token, so a token never enters a transcript.

configuration.constraints: Plugin storage; this machine's own addresses are always allowed.

failureModes: An old Host without this plugin leaves the section with a restart-and-retry message instead of controls.
Rotating replaces the previous token at once; clients using it get 401 until updated.
